written_by: Agent 7, twelve-hour training operation and candidate freeze

launch_record.trainer_log_note: the run wrote nothing to stdout or stderr for its entire life; all telemetry went to telemetry.jsonl

authorized_identities.run_digest_source: read back from the terminal checkpoint and matched to the launch manifest

setup.initialization: from scratch, seed 17, no Agent 3/4 state

start_identity.verified_before_launch_by_agent_7: both identities recomputed directly, covering the two the dry run omits under A6-C2

termination.operator_authorization: explicit; supersedes the frozen 640-iteration horizon requirement
termination.signal_detail: SIGTERM to learner 2209; caffeinate 2211 exited with its child and needed no separate signal
termination.graceful_handler_note: no signal handling exists anywhere in the frozen closure, so SIGTERM ended the process immediately and session.close() did not run. The operator's instruction anticipated this: the terminal committed state is the newest fully written telemetry row and the checkpoint it names.

in_progress_iteration_discarded_detail.evidence: the loop condition was still true at signal time, so iteration 536 was mid-step. Telemetry was byte-identical before and after termination (29971749 bytes, 535 lines), the checkpoint count did not change (535), no joint_00536.pt exists, and no temporary or partial file was left behind. The discarded iteration produced no committed artifact of any kind.

integrity_state.setup_consumption_rule: every episode completed in an iteration consumed exactly once in that iteration; cumulative enqueued equals cumulative consumed at 467872

terminal_committed_state.checkpoint_accepted_detail: read_joint_checkpoint accepted it with run_id RUN-2026-B, the authorized config digest and the authorized source digest, so no identity check refused it
terminal_committed_state.no_export_was_owed_detail: the next boundary would have been 46800 s, past the 43200 s export horizon, so no candidate was pending and none was created at termination
terminal_committed_state.must_not_be_evaluated_detail: this checkpoint is at iteration 535, past h12 at iteration 510, and its EMA states were never exported as a candidate. Per the operator instruction Agent 5 evaluates only the 25 frozen paired EMA candidates, never this checkpoint and never the current raw weights.

candidates.immutability_proof: every candidate's file hash, manifest digest and both EMA digests were recorded when it was written and recomputed after termination; all 25 are byte-identical, so nothing was overwritten, renamed or silently replaced

a6_c1_resolution.condition: A6-C1 allowed 24 or 25 candidates depending on whether production averaged above or below 67.5 s per iteration
a6_c1_resolution.why: production averaged 85.177 s per iteration, well above the 67.5 s threshold and above both the 67.404 s Agent 4 estimate and the 67.995 s Agent 4B smoke rate, so the 43200 s export horizon was reached at iteration 510, with 130 iterations of the frozen horizon still unrun at termination

late_telemetry_direction.basis: mean of the first ten iterations against the mean of the last ten; direction only, no strength claim

A6-C1.outcome: 25 candidates, last ordinal h12; the run was terminated by the operator before N=640 rather than falling short of h12

A6-C2.outcome: Agent 7 recomputed both identities the dry run omits before launch; h0 matched the manifest exactly for both move and setup

A6-C3.outcome: the setup advantage entropy-to-outcome magnitude ratio ranged 0.491 to 4.596 over the run with median 1.073, first-ten mean 1.727 and last-ten mean 1.067. It is volatile rather than trending; no compensating scale, floor, centering rule or controller was applied

A6-C4.outcome: the per-resume telemetry row loss was already closed by Agent 4C; this run never resumed, so the path was not exercised

P6_detail.note: move entropy declined steadily and came within about 13 percent of the P6 threshold without ever crossing it; no warning fired at any point in the run

observations_for_agent_5: no strength claim and no checkpoint recommendation is made here; this closeout reports training facts only
move entropy fell from about 1.67 to about 0.40 while setup empirical entropy fell from about 1.69 to about 1.37, so concentration appeared on both halves, the move half more sharply
mean game length fell from about 270 plies to about 145, which raised setup episode arrivals and is the reason iteration cost rose from about 68 s to a median of 85 s
the seat results are close to balanced across 233936 games at 111099 blue wins to 111820 red wins with 11017 draws, a 4.7 percent draw rate

the last 130 iterations of the frozen horizon were not run, so the move learning rate and entropy schedules did not complete their anneal; candidates are unaffected because all 25 were published by iteration 510
prohibited_work_not_performed: no evaluation of any candidate, checkpoint or raw weight set
no Agent 5 evaluator, worker, publisher or transport process was started at any time
no smoke test or test campaign was run
no change to training source, configuration or schedules
no candidate was fabricated, overwritten, renamed or omitted
no resume was performed and none will be

handoff.basis: the trainer is stopped and no Phase 17 process remains; all 25 candidate ordinals 0 through 24 are present, contiguous, individually verified and byte-identical to write time; the terminal checkpoint verifies against its telemetry-recorded file hash and payload digest and is accepted under the authorized run, config and source identities; the source closure still digests to the authorized value
handoff.agent_5_evaluates: only the 25 frozen paired EMA candidates in checkpoints/phase17/RUN-2026-B/exports
agent_5_must_not_evaluate: any raw move or setup weights
any post-h12 state that was never exported
